claim_text: our performance does compare favourably with other industry benchmarks.
metric_name: Group TRIF; ASX Mining Peers Avg TRIF; ICMM TRIF
context_text: Our Group TRIF was 1.7 at 30 June 2025 as we recorded an additional injury this year. rationale_short: TRIF 1.7低于图示的ASX Mining Peers Avg 2.3和ICMM 5.6，直接支持“compare favourably with other industry benchmarks”。
